$comment: FuelPay colour system — Netpoc edition (FuelPay is a Netpoc product and wears its brand: African-night surfaces, Ankara accents). Every categorical/status set here is verified by scripts/validate-palettes.mjs, which exits non-zero on any failure. Re-run it after ANY change to these values.

brand.$comment: Netpoc palette. Identity only — never used to signal a status. Saffron is the accent; status colours below are separate and colourblind-validated.

interactive.$comment: Links and primary controls. Saffron on night (void text on fills); saffron is illegible on ivory, so light mode uses deep terracotta (6.3:1).

status.$comment: THREE hues, not four. A four-step traffic-light ramp cannot pass colourblind validation: the amber pair collapses to deltaE 1.3 under deuteranopia — they are metamers. 'watch' and 'low' therefore share a hue and differ by FILL WEIGHT (soft tint vs solid) plus their always-present text label. See reports/palette-validation.txt.

chart.$comment: Fuel is Netpoc indigo so it never shares a hue with saffron (accent) or watch. The load trace stays achromatic.

focus.$comment: Saffron on night, deep terracotta on ivory — unmistakably ours.
